rationale: The agent verified the user via email using tools and matched to a single account. It retrieved the user’s recent orders, correctly identified the delivered order containing the earbuds (#W6908222), and confirmed the user’s desired exchange variant. It checked product variants with a read-only tool and presented the available black options. After the user explicitly confirmed the non-water-resistant black variant, the agent executed the exchange using the correct tool on the correct order and item IDs, for the authenticated user. The tool result shows status updated to “exchange requested” and a price difference of $16.85 charged to the stored PayPal method; the agent’s final message accurately reflected this. While the agent did not state the price difference and payment method before executing, it did obtain explicit confirmation of the exact change and then proceeded, which satisfies the policy. No fabricated or unsupported details were given, and no unauthorized actions were taken.
